Marta (Finance): Heads up — noticed ~40 invoices created yesterday ended up with bill_date in the previous month after a webhook replay. Suspect NetSuite ingest used payload timestamp instead of received_at. Investigating. /cc @Samir (Eng)
Samir (Eng): ugh. do we have sample invoice ids?
Marta (Finance): yes — INV-2024-1092, INV-2024-1101, INV-2024-1123. I'll paste raw webhook id/payload in a sec.
billing-bot: webhook delivered and processed (event id evt_3KxY...). Replay flag: true
Leo (Eng-Infra): can you paste the webhook headers? suspect we set invoice_date = payload.created_at when replaying instead of using received_at.
Marta (Finance): header snippet:
```
X-Stripe-Signature: t=1700000000,v1=...
X-Webhook-Replayed: true
received_at: 2024-11-01T02:13:45Z
payload.created: 2024-10-31T23:59:50Z
```
Samir (Eng): confirmed — code path in ns_sync service uses `payload.invoice_date` if present. replayed events keep original created timestamp which is older; NetSuite mapping then classifies as prior month. we should always use received_at for accounting date unless explicit `billing_date_override` is set.
Leo (Eng-Infra): patch ready, short PR: set netsuite_invoice_date = if payload.billing_date_override then that else received_at. also add webhook dedupe using stripe_event_id as idempotency key.
Samir (Eng): rolling patch to staging now. will run backfill to update misdated invoices in NetSuite sandbox.
Olivia (Revenue Ops): for production impacted invoices — what's the remediation plan? We need to avoid revenue recognition drift and make sure downstream reports don't pick wrong period.
Marta (Finance): propose: 1) identify affected invoices (SQL below), 2) issue reversing credit memos dated the original wrong date, 3) re-create invoices with correct dates, 4) attach audit note + tag export for AR. approve?
Leo (Eng-Infra): SQL to find quickly:
```
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, netsuite_internal_id, created_at, netsuite_bill_date
FROM stripe_netsuite_sync
WHERE sync_date between '2024-11-01' and '2024-11-02'
AND netsuite_bill_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at);
```
Olivia (Revenue Ops): ok for finance approval. we need list by EOD.
Marta (Finance): agreed. Samir can you run that query and export CSV to /shared/finance/regs/1850004321-webhook-replay? then we can coordinate with NetSuite ops.
Samir (Eng): running now. expect CSV in 15m.
billing-bot: export complete: /shared/finance/regs/1850004321-webhook_replay.csv (41 rows)
Olivia (Revenue Ops): received. starting manual credit memo + recreate flow. tagging @Leo (Eng-Infra) for any idempotency checks.
Leo (Eng-Infra): monitoring patch rollout. will add metric and anomaly alert for netsuite_bill_date != received_at.
Marta (Finance): thx. also opening JIRA: FIN-8472 and ENG-1209. link: https://tracker.redwood.com/browse/ENG-1209
Samir (Eng): PR merged — prod deploy in 10m. Adding migration to re-run webhook consumer against DLQ for affected event ids.
Olivia (Revenue Ops): finance to confirm after reissue. Marta — once done can you update revenue schedule?
Marta (Finance): will do. marking this thread for postmortem. :memo:
